integrity: The finite discrete-Morse matchings and directed-incidence acyclicity are explicitly reproducible from the included source and certificate. Independent scientific validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns exactly the twelve-vertex Frucht graph and its eighteen single-edge deletions, not all asymmetric or cubic graphs. Source coverage is non-exhaustive and a mathematically equivalent unindexed work may exist.
title: The Frucht graph matching complex and its complete edge-deletion homotopy profile
